ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel coverage (~85%) with localized high-intensity (white) mottling at the distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Mottled high-intensity clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes; a solid low-intensity dark mass occupies the proximal and medial regions surrounding the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; approximate 60-degree interior angle at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; amplitude of variations is most pronounced on the outer third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory from the median notch extending to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white pixels concentrated along the upper-distal edges of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular fragmentation and deep indentations along the trailing edge of the right lobe, indicating significant past tissue loss.
